name: Annett
source: A strong light magician; the princess's nanny. She is a nice and caring young lady, but not just a "fairy godmother" character. Sometimes Annett acts lazy and egoistic. She has fun teasing Neyris. Annett doesn`t care what people think about her; this girl never regrets anything she does.
